# Everloot

> Free WoW: Forever tools and a database built from player addon uploads. Public data is sparse and depends on available corroborated reports.

## Available tools
- [Database](https://everloot.app/database): Entry point for uploaded loot observations, NPC sightings, quests and vendors.
- [Loot observations](https://everloot.app/database/drops): Observed item frequency per recorded loot window. These are not verified kills or kill-based drop probabilities.
- [Upload addon data](https://everloot.app/upload): Submit addon records with explicit sharing choices; named records require reviewed publication grants.
- [Gold per hour calculator](https://everloot.app/tools/gold-per-hour): Local calculator using the quantities, prices and time entered by the user.
- [Profession paths](https://everloot.app/tools/professions): Estimated recipe paths from uploaded recipes and prices; missing data remains unknown.
- [Collection gap](https://everloot.app/tools/collections): Compare uploaded collection and ownership records.
- [Guild board](https://everloot.app/tools/guild-board): Officer-authorized public uploads; no aggregate guild score is currently published.
- [Lore archive](https://everloot.app/lore): Warcraft Wiki pages as of 2023-11-13, CC BY-SA 4.0, searchable at https://everloot.app/search and browsable by NPCs, items, quests, zones and spells (https://everloot.app/lore/npcs and so on). https://everloot.app/lore/coverage reports what the archive covers. Not WoW: Forever data.

## Data limitations
- Distinct addon install IDs are not proof of independent people.
- No actual beta-client collection trial has been verified yet.
- Empty available storage and unavailable storage are different states.
- No number, name or position should be invented for an unknown entity.
- Farming routes and respawn optimization remain planned.
- The lore archive is a 2023 snapshot and predates WoW: Forever.

Everloot is a fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment.
